options.content: **Placeholder - intentionally empty.** Nothing ships Jenkins build/console logs to Loki yet. The controller (10.200.2.55) isn't part of this stack's Alloy docker-log fleet, so its container logs (including the `jenkins-agent` sidecar containers on `.52`/`.56`/`.48`, which only carry trivial sshd output anyway) aren't the same thing as actual build console output. Shipping real build logs needs either an Alloy/Promtail agent on `.55`, or Jenkins pushing console output directly - tracked as the next CI/CD step. Query below is pre-wired for when that lands.
